package store

import "github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"

// RawPool is the bypass: a plain function, no receiver at all, that hands back the raw pool
// pulled out of a *Queries argument -- a guard that requires fn.Recv != nil never sees it, even
// though the caller ends up with exactly the same unscoped pool a method getter would hand out.
func RawPool(q *Queries) *pgxpool.Pool {
	return q.pool
}
